listing.name: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream (tomodachi-native)
listing.summary: An experimental Tomodachi Life-specific nxnative-derived Apple ARM64/Horizon/Metal 4 adaptation. The project reports a Mac island tour, naming, Mii creation and sound, with later-scene input limits and busy scenes at 55 FPS; a full playthrough is unconfirmed. iPad Air M2/iPadOS 27 has limited startup/run evidence, while iPhone builds are unrun and Mac controllers are unavailable. macOS 26 is the target, but development/testing used macOS 27 and 26 is untried. Build locally with build_mac_app.py; optional embedding copies/clones your own data into Application Support, and keep-data rebuilds preserve RomFS. iOS needs local building/signing with separate game content. There is no release package. Use your own version 1.0.0 NSP, title 010051F0207B2000, prod.keys and locally rewritten v0 modules/RomFS/shaders. Other regions/updates are unconfirmed. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
